verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party batch-jobs feature that runs large SQL operations as retryable task batches, with live progress and pause/retry/cancel controls (docs-15). Cross-table partition operations work by reference without copying rows (docs-33), and async inserts buffer many small writes (docs-37). Agents can run SQL over MCP (docs-7), so an AI-native user can reach these bulk paths. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that agents can launch and control batch jobs via MCP or an API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bulk-operation features.
